test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 18th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

The archer aimed at the **bow **carefully.

options.text: The captain stood at the bow of the ship to watch the horizon.
She practiced with her bow and arrow every morning.
The wooden bow was crafted from high-quality yew.
He held the bow steady while reaching for a new arrow.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (The captain stood at the bow of the ship to watch the horizon)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bow"** in the original sentence refers to a weapon used by an archer. (धनुष)

 
 
• **Example:** The archer aimed at the bow carefully before releasing the arrow.
 
 
 
• In the correct option, **"bow"** refers to the front part of a ship. (जहाज़ का अग्रभाग)
 
 
• **Example:** The captain stood at the bow of the ship to watch the horizon.
 
 
 
• Hence, the homonym of **"bow"** is found in the sentence about the ship.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option (The captain stood at the bow of the ship to watch the horizon)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **She practiced with her bow and arrow every morning** (धनुष और बाण)

 
 
• **Example:** She practiced with her bow and arrow every morning to improve her aim.
 
 
 
• **The wooden bow was crafted from high-quality yew** (लकड़ी का धनुष)
 
 
• **Example:** The wooden bow was crafted from high-quality yew for durability.
 
 
 
• **He held the bow steady while reaching for a new arrow** (धनुष)
 
 
• **Example:** He held the bow steady while reaching for a new arrow to maintain accuracy.
